## PhyloTreeProps.leafMarkerColor property

One colour for every leaf marker (e.g. `"currentColor"` for neutral dots), instead of the per-leaf colours seeded by `colorFunction`<!-- -->. `nodeStyles` still overrides it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
leafMarkerColor?: string;
```
